title: Codex CLI 0.142.0 Released
description: OpenAI released Codex CLI 0.142.0 with enhanced /usage command for rate-limit reset credits, improved /plugins organization with curated catalogs, configurable rollout token budgets, indexed web-search mode, and scheduled UTC time reminders. Major improvements to Linux TUI rendering, exec-server resilience, and plugin loading.

community_feedback.quote: Users requesting custom code review instructions for the Codex app's /review command

title: Codex App 26.616 with Record & Replay Feature
description: New Record & Replay feature on macOS that turns demonstrated workflows into reusable skills. Added bulk actions to automation run history, thread handoff between local and remote hosts, and performance improvements including 2x faster Browser Use through CDP optimizations.

community_feedback.quote: Record & Replay lets you demonstrate a workflow on your Mac and turn it into a reusable skill
Discussion around converting successful Codex sessions into reusable, parameterized YAML-based templates

title: Codex App Features Available in EEA, UK, and Switzerland
description: Codex app capabilities expanded to European Economic Area, UK, and Switzerland including Computer Use on macOS and Windows, Codex Chrome extension for background tab work, Memories for preferences and workflows, and Chronicle as opt-in research preview for Pro subscribers.

title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.167 Update
description: Added per-host personality settings (Friendly and Pragmatic), goal editing in composer, forked conversation links, improved side chat visibility, composer autocomplete, progress visibility for subagents, and fixed long thread loading issues.

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — May Update
description: June 2026 brought sharper tooling for planning, reviewing, and managing work with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026. New Plan agent lets you collaborate on implementation plans before coding, Skills panel for managing agent skills, multi-file summary diff for Copilot changes, and context window usage management.

community_feedback.quote: Copilot is no longer a code suggestion tool. In 2026, GitHub Copilot in agent mode reads a GitHub Issue, spins up dedicated branches, writes code, and runs tasks autonomously

title: Surgical Code Edits and Session Export/Import (v0.43.0)
description: Released v0.43.0 with surgical code edits that prefer the edit tool for speed and precision, session export/import for portability, and adaptive token estimation for better context management efficiency.

title: Continue Acquisition by Cursor
description: Continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor. The website displays a notice stating 'Continue has been acquired by Cursor' with a commitment to ensuring developers are amplified, not automated. VS Code extension last updated on June 18-19, 2026.

community_feedback.quote: Why the Cursor Acquisition Should Concern Everyone... I've been a Cursor user for a long time and today's acquisition news genuinely worries me
Continue serves well for minor in-context tasks within the IDE, while Aider is better suited for more complex work

title: MCP Marketplace Expansion
description: Devin release notes show MCP Marketplace expansion with 48+ new engineering connectors now available, including integrations with Miro, Mixpanel, Honeycomb, Postman, monday.com, Klaviyo, and many others.
